heading: `retracted` and `wm` semantics
text:
### `retracted` and `wm` semantics [LTSL.8.6]

`retracted <Schema> …` holds when a matching fact left working memory during the run
— by TTL expiry or logical supersedure. `wm has` / `wm count` / `wm empty` are
checked against working memory at the **end** of the run: `has` holds when some
matching fact is live, `count == N` when exactly N matching facts are live, and
`empty` when working memory holds no facts.
